title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Fed's Sept 15-16 meeting looms with traders pricing ~80-90% odds of a 25bp hike after hot core CPI (+0.3% M/M); 10-yr yield near 4.97%.

Markets: Oil eased over the weekend, with Brent back to ~$104-105/bbl from a $108 spike, as Trump-Saudi contacts and Houthi assurances calmed fears; VIX fell ~11% Friday as stocks snapped a 4-day skid (S&P +0.9%, Dow +509, Nasdaq +1%).

Macro/Policy: Trump spoke with the Saudi Crown Prince Saturday; Riyadh held off retaliating (at Iraq's request) after its East-West pipeline was hit, and the Houthis pledged to target only Saudi-flagged vessels in the Bab al-Mandeb, not general shipping.
Macro/Policy: Iran says it will meet Gulf states in Oman this week over Strait of Hormuz security, a second chokepoint to watch alongside Wednesday's Fed decision.

Macro/Policy: Congress in 'AI alarm' mode after a doomsday warning from an ex-Anthropic researcher; House Democrats push to recall Congress and fast-track AI safeguards (kill switches, model pause) while GOP leadership resists, a policy overhang for AI-linked stocks.
Companies: Bloom Energy added to the S&P 500; SpaceX's index weighting increase in the Nasdaq 100 also in focus this week.
